items.title: Broader markets underperform, extend losing streak to third week
items.description: The Nifty Midcap 100 index declined 2% during the week, with PB Fintech, One 97 Communications (Paytm), Oracle Financial Services Software, L&T Finance, Container Corporation of India, Adani Total Gas, Tata Investment Corporation falling 7-33%.

items.title: Markets extend 7-week losing streak as crude, yields and FII selling weigh
items.description: Sectoral indices ended mixed during the week, with the Nifty IT index falling 2.4%, while Nifty Private Bank declined 1.5% and Nifty Energy shed nearly 1%. On the other hand, Nifty Realty emerged as the top gainer, rising 3%, while Nifty Consumer Durables, Pharma and FMCG indices advanced around 1% each.

items.title: Wall Street ends higher as investors buy AI stocks; Microsoft rallies
items.description: The S&P 500 climbed 0.51% to end the session at 7,743.41 points. The Nasdaq gained 0.48% to 27,068.72 points, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average ​rose 0.93% to 51,828.62 points.
